To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the scheduling of household activities is an important determinant of travel behavior and that the scheduling of activities is a consequence of a complex process of information acquisition and processing.
the operational model is capable of producing realistic results and that the theory underlying the operational model is consistent with existing psychological theory.
a model based on a theory of information use in activity scheduling is able to produce realistic effects of work schedules, living location, and travel speeds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a theory and an operational model of household travel behavior that is based on the behavioral principles of information acquisition, information processing, and choice of action.
the development of an activity-based model for travel demand analysis, which will be useful for the evaluation of transportation policies.
the development of a new approach to the modeling of household activity scheduling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the theory is promising and the operational model is promising but needs further development.
the proposed model and theory have potential for explaining the scheduling of activities, but that much more research is needed to develop and validate the model.
the proposed theory and the operational model based on it constitute a promising new approach to the analysis of household activity scheduling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a promising approach to the modeling of household activity scheduling has been proposed.
a behavioral theory of household activity scheduling can be developed, and that it can be operationalized and used for realistic computer simulations.
we are now ready to begin to understand how persons make their daily activity schedules.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the scheduling theory and operational model can serve as a basis for developing a comprehensive model of activity-travel behavior.
activity-based models are not only a promising alternative to the traditional trip-based models but also that they can be developed and used in the same way.
a behavioral approach to modeling household activity scheduling can be useful in the study of activity scheduling and travel behavior.
